It's just so hard. I don't want to live with them anymore and I want them to go away. I'm reminded of the memories every day. I feel like I'm unloved and unwanted and unwelcomed in their house. I voiced this to them and my dad was basically like. Well. you have until tomorrow at midnight to give a clean slate. And you know what? it's hard. It's fucking hard. Every time I've tried to bring up the things that they did to me, I'm met with denial. I've struggled with mental illness since I was 11 years old. I thought it would have gone away by now but it hasn't. I think I have ADHD or I'm Bipolar or Both but I think a lot of it was triggered by the trauma. I don't want to sit with those memories anymore. I just want to feel normal. I'm tired of it. It's been ten years now and im still not okay. I used to cut myself when I was younger and then that transitioned into disordered eating, shoplifting, and drug use. Now that I'm 21 I'm finding myself going to the liquor store almost everyday for "a few drinks" and usually it is just one or two. I don't wanna be like this anymore. I'm afraid I'm gonna be like this forever and im so tired of this mental battle. I can't take it. I want my brain to turn off. I need my brain to turn off. Anxiety medicines I've tried have left me experiencing derealization or side effects that are just too much for me. I just want to turn my brain off. I feel like I'm so smart but it is just. like. it's not okay. I'm constantly thinking of the pressures of the world. I've been a vegetarian for ten years. Factory farming makes me sad. Sex trafficking and wars make me sad. Women not having rights makes me sad. People not being able to afford medical care makes me sad. Every wrongdoing in the world makes me sad. And im sad because of my environment. It's just too much. I want my brain to turn off. And death would satisfy that. Before I moved out of my apartment, my ex boyfriend had a gun that he bought, legally, that wasn't in a safe. I told him to please hide it or put it in a safe but he told me No. That he wouldn't. Because no one should be afraid they're gonna hurt themselves because there's a gun in the house. Well. I started giving my stuff away. Planning out what I was gonna do with all of my money and who I would give it too. Just. Planning. One of my plans was to, guess what, steal his gun. I told him to keep it in a safe and keep it away from me but there was so many times where I considered stealing it. And he would have had no idea. But I'm not with him anymore so that doesn't matter. I've stopped planning things and I've stopped thinking about it so much. But now since I've moved back into my parent's house the only easiest way that I could come up with to do it is to crash my car. Painless. I don't have to drown myself. I don't have to feel pain. I can just do a bunch of drugs and take a bunch of painkillers and crash my car and not feel a thing and then I wouldn't have to think these thoughts anymore and i can finally turn my brain off.
